summary: Chicago area resident, former system administrator, electronics technician, and machinist, experienced in Turbo Pascal and Delphi programming, currently learning Lazarus/Free Pascal, strong interest in capability-based security, advocates for multilevel secure operating systems, engaged in DIY electronics and software-defined radio, has a child, interested in computational fabrics and programming languages, follows podcasts related to technology and productivity, has a history of working with atomic clocks and CNC machining, values privacy and security in technology, and has a critical view of current operating systems and their security models.
